_meta.component: Maximum lodging rate only, per night, before taxes; meals and incidentals (M&IE) excluded.
_meta.meaning: These are ceilings, not prices. A US federal civilian traveler is reimbursed actual lodging cost up to this maximum (lodging taxes are reimbursed separately for CONUS). GSA sets CONUS rates each fiscal year (1 Oct - 30 Sep) from market data on hotel average daily rates; the State Department's Office of Allowances sets foreign (OCONUS) rates, reviewed on a rolling monthly publication cycle, from surveys of hotel prices at each post. They say what an acceptable mid-range business hotel costs there, not what a resident pays in rent.
_meta.gsaMethod: GSA per diem API v2 (api.gsa.gov/travel/perdiem/v2/rates/city/{city}/state/{st}/year/2026), the data behind https://www.gsa.gov/travel/plan-book/per-diem-rates. Month values are for FY2026: Oct-Dec are 2025, Jan-Sep are 2026.
_meta.stateMethod: Queried post by post on https://allowances.state.gov/web920/per_diem_action.asp (aoprals.state.gov redirects there), for the 09/01/2026 publication (in force in September 2026) and the 10/01/2026 publication. Lodging was identical in both for every post; only Seoul's M&IE changed (126 -> 132).

conusStandard.source: GSA per diem API v2, FY2026 'Standard Rate' row (e.g. /rates/city/.../state/KS/year/2026); https://www.gsa.gov/travel/plan-book/per-diem-rates

us-dc-washington.gsaArea: District of Columbia (also Alexandria, Falls Church, Fairfax city, Arlington and Fairfax counties VA; Montgomery and Prince George's counties MD)

kr-11-seoul.effective: 2026-09-01 row (09/01/2026 publication); unchanged lodging in 10/01/2026 publication

uncertain: GSA FY2027 rates (from 2026-10-01) were not checked: the GSA API's DEMO_KEY hit its rate limit. The FY2026 figures above are the ones in force in September 2026.

The State Department site shows a footnote link ('View') for Seoul, London, Paris, Tokyo City, Toronto and Sao Paulo; the footnote text was not read. It may carry conditions or other-locality notes, but the lodging number itself is as tabled.
Tokyo: two posts exist, 'Tokyo City' (346) and 'Tokyo-To' (PCode 11480), which returned no data in either publication. Tokyo City is used.
The 'meaning' text is a general description of how GSA and State set these rates, not a quotation from either page.
GSA month values are FY-ordered: Oct-Dec belong to calendar 2025, Jan-Sep to 2026. New Orleans' Oct-Jan band spans the year boundary.
